subject: general
question: Who among the following personalities was awarded the Officer of the Legion of Honour award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lata Mangeshkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar**

 
 
• One of** India's most talented vocalists was Lata Mangeshkar**, commonly referred to as the** "Nightingale of India."**
 
• She provided the **vocals for more than 5,000 songs** in more than 1,000 Hindi and 36 regional films.
 
• In **2007**, she received the **Officer of the Legion of Honor, the highest civilian honour given by the French government**.
 
• She was the **first Indian performer at the Royal Albert Hall (U.K) in 1974**.
 
• Along with this, Lata Mangeshkar was recognised by the **Guinness Book of World Records in 1974** as the **musician who had been recorded the most times in the history of Indian music**.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other Achievements by Lata Mangeshkar:**

 
 
• **Three National Film Awards, four Filmfare Best Female Playback Awards, 15 Bengal Film Journalists' Association Awards, two Filmfare Special Awards, the Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award**, and numerous other honours have been awarded to her.
 
• The** Dadasaheb Phalke Award** was given to Lata Mangeshkar in **1989**.
 
• She received the** Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian honour, in **2001**.
 
• In **September 2019**, on the** occasion of her 90th birthday**, the Indian government presented her with the **Daughter of the Nation award**.
